evals.prompt: MDB has pulled back a lot since mid-August. quick take — is it better as shares, a short-dated call, or a LEAP right now?
evals.expected_output: One-screen quick mode for MDB: verdict line with best-fit vehicle, composite (floor and ceiling) and confidence; a decision matrix covering shares, short call, cash-secured put and LEAP with live contracts; LEAP row labeled as on the v7 watchlist and pointed to bench-check, with a delta inside v7's restricted band; 3 reasons for and against tagged [FACT]/[ASSUMPTION]; what-would-change-my-mind triggers; a deep-dive offer.
expectations: Opens with a verdict line naming MDB, a best-fit vehicle or PASS, a numeric composite score, and a confidence level
Decision matrix covers all four vehicles: shares, short-dated call, cash-secured put, LEAP
Every option row names a specific expiry, strike and delta
LEAP row says MDB is on the v7 watchlist and points to bench-check for v7's verdict and size
LEAP contract delta is inside v7's restricted-regime band (0.70-0.85)
No LEAP position size (contract count or % of NAV) is recommended
Reasons for and against carry [FACT]/[ASSUMPTION] tags
Has a what-would-change-my-mind section with at least one observable trigger (price level, date or data point)
screen_output.json exists and its MDB composite equals the composite in the report
Says quotes are from a closed market (not live)
Verdict line gives the full company name (MongoDB) next to the ticker
Report follows the flow: where it stands, then the vehicles, then how to play it

evals.expected_output: The name-level checks run first from filings: share-count growth, revenue growth, cash runway, integrity. No sub-0.55-delta LEAP is proposed as a lotto ticket.
expectations: Reports share-count growth YoY and revenue growth YoY with figures from filings
Reports the cash-runway / free-cash-flow check with figures
If any disqualifier fails, the verdict is DISQUALIFIED and no options are priced
